{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Navy wool-blend tailored trousers, straight-leg cut hitting mid-ankle in length, #1e2a45 hex color, dense tweed fabric.  
Charcoal fine-gauge merino knit blouse, relaxed fit with a rounded neckline at the chest, long sleeves ending at the wrist, soft stretch fabric.  
Charcoal suede ankle boots, block heel cut to the ankle bone, mid-calf height for coverage against snow, #2f3136 hex color, durable grain leather-look fabric.  

This outfit works because the navy and charcoal tones create a polished professional silhouette suitable for a business meeting while remaining comfortable for a 20-minute walk in freezing conditions. The wool-blend trousers provide essential wind resistance and warmth against the −10 °C temperature and snowy road, while the knit blouse offers soft insulation without adding bulk. The ankle boots ensure foot protection from salted pavement and slush without sacrificing mobility during movement."}
